name: Midara na Sono no Alice ~Toukou Hen~
original_name: 淫らな園のアリス～登校編～
source:
Arisu Himenogi, a top student in her class and the vice president of the student council, had a small but persistent problem.
She couldn’t handle her own overly sexual body.
One day, while doing something lewd and outrageous in an empty classroom, something strange happened to her.
She found herself face-to-face with… herself. A version of her from a parallel world—her, but not her.
Now, Arisu’s consciousness is swapped between two worlds: the mundane, boring one she’s always known, and a lewd, outrageous one where her other self thrives.
What kind of school life awaits her now…?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ060789.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
姬乃木爱丽丝是班里的尖子生，也是学生会副会长，但她有一个小而顽固的问题。
她无法控制自己过度淫荡的身体。
一天，她在空教室里做着淫秽而出格的事情时，发生了奇怪的事。
她发现自己正与……另一个自己面对面。那是来自平行世界的她——是她，却又不是她。
如今，爱丽丝的意识在两个世界之间交换：一个是她一直熟悉的平凡无聊世界，另一个则是淫靡放荡、另一个自己如鱼得水的世界。
她的校园生活将会迎来什么……？
